verdict.rationale: Poke itself functions as the built-in AI assistant, and docs show it can perform delegated tasks—managing integrations, deploying websites, booking real-world services, and connecting MCP tools—via natural conversation, going beyond a simple chatbot into agentic task execution. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of successful task delegation beyond vendor docs (the only community evidence found relates to a security/prompt-injection issue, not delegation capability).
